applicationScope: Active for taxonomy v0.2.0 result records. Legacy aggregate CSVs and policy-1.0.0 categories remain source-history fields only; current categories must be re-derived under this policy.
name: Hybrid research-challenge metric
purpose: A transparent indicator of documented prior status, scale of advance, scope and demonstrated resistance. It is not an intrinsic difficulty, assurance or mathematical-importance score.

priorTarget.definition: The exact question, conjecture, record or quantitative frontier is documented in a source predating the AI work.

coding.0: No qualifying prior target is established by the coded evidence.
coding.1: A qualifying prior target is established by at least one cited predating source.

advance.definition: The mathematical advance relative to the anchor claim.

coding.1: Material improvement, new theorem, construction, counterexample or substantial subcase without complete settlement of the anchor claim.
coding.2: Complete proof or disproof, classification, matching optimum, sharp endpoint or removal of the central condition for the anchor claim.

scope.definition: Whether the result is uniform or worst-case over an unbounded or genuinely general class.

coding.0: A fixed finite instance, narrow family or otherwise non-general scope.
coding.1: A uniform or worst-case result over an unbounded or genuinely general class.

resistance.definition: Demonstrated resistance of the exact target before the tracked solution.

coding.0: The coded evidence does not meet the resistance rule.
coding.1: At least two independent pre-solution attempts at the exact target, or a predeclared target-specific comparison with at least five independent runs or systems and no more than 20 percent success.

missingness.rule: Missing or inapplicable inputs are never coerced to zero. If any P/A/S/R input is non-numeric, the derived score retains an explicit state using the precedence not_applicable, unknown, not_reported; baseCategory and category are exactly incomplete; and superhumanEligible is false. Missing dates or provisional status do not change a complete P/A/S/R base category, but they prevent the Superhuman override while their explicit states remain visible.

superhumanOverride.label: Superhuman
superhumanOverride.rationale: An operational mathematical-history category for complete settlements of precisely documented, demonstrably resistant targets that remained open for at least a decade. A minimal passed-event evidence floor keeps an unverified source assertion from receiving the override; verification strength and review status remain independent assurance dimensions.
allRequired: at least 10.0 elapsed years separate documented precise framing and solution
at least one recorded verification event has outcome passed

elapsedYears.calculation: Use day difference divided by 365.2425 when both dates have day precision; use month difference divided by 12 when month is the coarsest precision; otherwise use the difference between recorded calendar years. Round to three decimal places.
elapsedYears.note: A year-precision value is a documented calendar-year gap, not a day-exact duration. Date precision remains visible in the record.

categoryIndependence.rule: These fields remain evidence-backed and separately displayed. Beyond the minimal requirement that some recorded verification event passed, neither their presence nor their strength changes Expected, Difficult or Superhuman category eligibility.
fields: substantive prior-attempt count beyond the coded resistance input
verification independence, scope, correspondence, method strength and replay beyond the passed-event floor

completionEnvelope.purpose: Describe the set of final categories reachable if missing P/A/S/R evidence were later resolved, without replacing the stored missing values or changing the authoritative incomplete category.
completionEnvelope.appliesWhen: At least one P/A/S/R value is unknown, not_reported or not_applicable.
completionEnvelope.enumerationRule: For unknown and not_reported inputs, enumerate the full Cartesian product of the numeric domains declared by this policy while holding all recorded nonmissing inputs, R2, dates, provisional status and verification evidence fixed.
completionEnvelope.notApplicableRule: If any missing input is not_applicable, resolution is structurally_incomplete, scoreRange is null, category sets are empty and completionInvariantCategory is null.
completionEnvelope.authoritativeCategoryRule: The stored category remains incomplete until all P/A/S/R inputs have numeric evidence. The envelope is counterfactual and supplies neither an imputed value, a probability nor a confidence judgment.

resolutions.completion_invariant: Every enumerated numeric completion produces the same final category; that category is recorded in completionInvariantCategory without replacing category=incomplete.
resolutions.ambiguous: Enumerated numeric completions produce more than one final category; completionInvariantCategory is null.
resolutions.structurally_incomplete: At least one component is not applicable to the metric, so there is no numeric completion set.

exclusions: A passed verification event is a minimal evidence floor; verification method strength, independence, scope, correspondence and replay do not add points to D or otherwise block the Superhuman override.
Statement-correspondence confidence and review status remain visible assurance fields and do not block the Superhuman override.
AI autonomy does not add points to D.
Prestige, proof length and compute do not add points to D.
The Superhuman override is a policy category and is not evidence of intrinsic importance, formal correctness or universal superiority to humans.
